background.description: Plain light background; UPSC has historically been less strict on exact pixel dimensions than SSC/IBPS but enforces the KB range and a recent, unedited photograph

notes: PLACEHOLDER SEED DATA: UPSC's dimension/KB rules have varied notably between cycles and are typically looser than SSC/IBPS. Confirm against the live UPSC notification before relying on this preset (see PRD open question Q2).
